title: Medical bill: itemise + reduce
summary: Request a fully itemised bill, check for errors, and ask about financial assistance or a settlement.
channel: Written request to the billing office
goal_default: I am also requesting information on financial-assistance / charity-care programs and any prompt-pay discount, and I would like to discuss a reasonable settlement or a 0% payment plan.

rights.claim: You can request a fully itemised bill; errors and duplicate billing codes are common.
rights.basis: Standard medical-billing practice; itemised statements available on request.

rights.claim: Many hospitals have financial-assistance / charity-care programs that are under-advertised.
A prompt-pay cash discount is often available if you ask.

artifact.subject: Request for itemised bill and financial review{{account_suffix}}
artifact.body:
To: {{target}} Billing Office

Hello,

Please send a fully itemised bill listing each charge and billing code{{account_suffix}}. I want to review it for errors before payment.

{{goal}}

Please pause any collection activity while this review is in progress.

Sincerely,
{{name}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal or financial advice and guarantees no outcome.
